name: Giza
about: The Giza plateau: Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure with their queens' pyramids, the Sphinx, the temples and causeways, the mastaba fields, and Nazlet el-Samman at the foot of the escarpment. At New York's scale (6 units a metre) so Abel's paramotor flies between them at their true size. Ground: uv run 3d/dem-to-glb.py src/locations/giza.json assets/locations/giza.glb; monuments and town: uv run 3d/giza-to-glb.py src/locations/giza.json assets/locations/giza-monuments.glb

flatten.name: Sphinx enclosure
flatten.about: The pit the Sphinx was carved out of, open to its temples in the east

flatten.name: Nazlet el-Samman
flatten.about: The town on the valley floor: the surface model carries its rooftops, the buildings come from giza-to-glb.py

pyramids.name: Great Pyramid of Khufu
pyramids.about: 230.3 m square, 146.6 m to its lost apex, 138.5 m standing: 203 courses of core blocks with every casing stone gone, a flat top 10 m across and the mast that marks the old apex

pyramids.name: Pyramid of Khafre
pyramids.about: 215.3 m square, 143.5 m, 136.4 m standing on a terrace 10 m above Khufu's; its top still wears the smooth white casing, and its first course was granite

pyramids.name: Pyramid of Menkaure
pyramids.about: 102.2 by 104.6 m, 65.5 m, 61 m standing; the lowest sixteen courses cased in red granite, and the gash in its north face from 1196

pyramids.name: Queen's Pyramid G3-b
pyramids.about: A step pyramid in four steps, never cased

pyramids.name: Queen's Pyramid G3-c
pyramids.about: A step pyramid in four steps, never cased

pyramids.name: Tomb of Khentkawes I
pyramids.about: A giant sarcophagus on a block of bedrock: two steps

sphinx.about: 73 m long, 20 m high, facing the sunrise; on the floor of its enclosure

ruins.about: Height in metres of the OpenStreetMap footprints giza-to-glb.py raises, by name; mastabas and other ruins are 2.5-6.5 m, modern buildings take their levels or 9 m

town.about: Nazlet el-Samman and the end of Pyramids Road, which OpenStreetMap barely maps: blocks of brick and concrete four to six storeys high on the flat ground below the escarpment, clear of the Sphinx's temples

plain.about: Giza is inland: past the terrain the desert runs on, flat, at the valley floor's height

look.about: Morning over the desert: a low sun in the east lights the faces Abel flies towards and the Sphinx's face, which looks at the sunrise, through a warm dusty haze

soaringLoop.about: Abel's paramotor tour, [lat, lon, metres above sea level]: an oval along the line of the three pyramids, so one is nearly always ahead. In front of the Sphinx's face, west past the valley temples and south-west past Khafre to Menkaure, west between its top and its queens, north-east up the far side past Khafre to the Great Pyramid, round its north face, then south between it and its queens and on to the Sphinx. The app gives every leg the same time, so they're about the same length. giza-to-glb.py checks the curve keeps 10 m either side clear

camera.about: East of the Sphinx, looking west up at the three pyramids; [lat, lon, metres]
